The three for's on marked objects belong to the object markers under rule 16's first family, since the English make atonement reaches its object through that preposition; the for's on עַל are the prepositions' own.
The second and third יְכַפֵּר units are discontinuous from their objects under rule 25, because the ASV fronts he shall make atonement ahead of the phrases the Hebrew puts before the verb.
the holy sanctuary is rule 29's fronting case: the rectum is rendered attributively, so its article takes the written the.
